## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so reminders are not sent to customers who already paid. Router splitting remains paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Go method: `fetch_account` (`get_user_record` superseded). Tag: `rename-fetch-account-v1`. Payments host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev` (`sbx-pay-a` superseded). SMS retry label: `sms:delivery_attempt`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Do not increase SQLAlchemy pool size to 50; it caused staging contention/deadlocks. Do not remove billing events before `record_usage_event()`; failed persistence would lose retries.

- [pending] Reproduce paid-customer reminder behavior with focused tests.

- [pending] Update Go call sites, test, tag, and force-push tag.

## Recent work
CLI billing filters were deduplicated; 37 tests passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. A billing-filter abbreviation regression test was added.
